info.title: Logiwa Open API
info.description:
Overview

Logiwa offers a suite of APIs that allow developers to extend the platform’s built-in features. These APIs enable partners to read and write data, as well as interoperate with other systems and platforms.

Base URLs

  • Sandbox: https://myapisandbox.logiwa.com Go to Developer Portal ↗
  • Production: https://myapi.logiwa.com Go to Developer Portal ↗

API Versioning

The endpoints in this document belong to version 3.1 unless otherwise specified. Endpoints belonging to different versions are specified in the section header of each endpoint (e.g., Version: v3.2 or Version: v3.3). Please ensure that you send the correct version number in the API requests you create.

Rate Limits

To ensure the stability and reliability of our API for all users, we implement rate limiting on the number of requests that can be made within a specific period.

Standard Endpoint Rate Limits:

  • Basic Tier Users: Limited to 2 requests per second.
  • Premium Tier Users: Allowed up to 6 requests per second.

Bulk Endpoint Rate Limits:

Bulk endpoints allow operations on multiple resources in a single request. A single bulk request can include a maximum of 50 objects.

  • Basic Tier Users: Limited to 1 bulk request every 6 seconds.
  • Premium Tier Users: Allowed 1 bulk request every 2 seconds.

While the above outlines our general rate-limiting policies, individual API endpoints may have additional, more specific limitations. Such information will be provided in the relevant section of the endpoint documentation.

Logiwa Query Language (LQL)

Many of our API endpoints support advanced filtering capabilities through the Logiwa Query Language (LQL). LQL allows you to construct powerful queries to retrieve specific datasets, enhancing the flexibility of your API interactions.

LQL queries are appended to the endpoint URL as a query string, starting after the question mark (?). The basic structure of an LQL filter is:

{fieldName}.{LQL_aggregator}={value}

Multiple LQL filters can be combined using the ampersand (&) character.

Example Endpoint Structure:

https://{subdomain}.logiwa.com/v{version}/{operationGroup}/i/{startIndex}/s/{pageSize}?{LQL_query}

LQL Aggregators

Aggregator Description Example Usage
gt Greater Than CreatedDate.gt=2024-01-01
gte Greater Than or Equal To Quantity.gte=10
lt Less Than Price.lt=50.00
lte Less Than or Equal To Weight.lte=2.5
eq Equal To Status.eq=Active
bt Between (inclusive) OrderDate.bt=2024-01-01,2024-01-31

Available Query Parameters

All fields that can be used for LQL filtering are listed as query parameters on their respective endpoints within this Swagger documentation. If an endpoint does not display any query parameters, it indicates that filtering via LQL is not supported for that specific method.

Filter Value Types

LQL supports various data types for filter values, including but not limited to:

  • Date: YYYY-MM-DD (e.g., 2024-03-04)
  • String: Case-sensitive (e.g., NI-HS0923-27022024A)
  • Identifier (GUID/UUID): e.g., 7546ad2f-81d1-4308-b744-2e29af43fc16
  • Numeric: Integers or decimals (e.g., 10, 49.99)

LQL Query Example:

Retrieve serial tracking data created between March 4th and March 5th, 2024, for a specific purchase order, SKU, client, warehouse, serial number, and status.

https://myapi.logiwa.com/v3.1/Report/SerialTracking/i/0/s/200?CreatedDate.bt=2024-03-04,2024-03-05&PurchaseOrderNumber.eq=NI-HS0923-27022024A&SKU.eq=HD_APPLE_WATCH_SE2_44MM_Silver_Blue&ClientIdentifier.eq=7546ad2f-81d1-4308-b744-2e29af43fc16&WarehouseIdentifier.eq=4b8aa8cc-2685-4cbd-87c6-4fa90c14b70c&PrimarySerialNumber.eq=sf702dqv4m0&SerialStatusName.eq=Received

Webhook List

New Platform Available: Experience 20x better performance and enhanced security with Webhooks V2.0. Featuring zero-event-loss retries and full payload compatibility with V1.

Explore V2.0: Webhook API Documentation

Below is a list of available webhooks to which you can subscribe:

  • wms/shipmentorder/statuschange
  • wms/shipmentorder/create

IP Whitelist: For webhook notifications from Logiwa to reach your system, the following IP addresses must be whitelisted on your firewall or security configuration.

  • Sandbox: 20.44.83.105

If these IP addresses are not whitelisted, webhook requests from Logiwa may be blocked and notifications may not be delivered to your system.

NOTE: When using a webhook, we recommend calling the necessary endpoint from the API at regular intervals to check for missing information flow.

HTTP Status Codes

Status Code Description What It Means
200 OK The request was successful.
201 Created The POST request was successful, and the entity has been returned in the response.
204 No Content The GET request was successful, and there is no content in the response.
400 Bad Request The request was malformed and could not be processed. If making an authorization request, this may mean the Token is not accurate.
401 Unauthorized The token provided is either invalid or expired. The token was not provided in the correct manner, or does not provide sufficient privileges for the action requested.
404 Not Found Either the URL format is invalid, or an entity with the specified ID does not exist.
413 Request Entity Too Large The length of the request content has exceeded the maximum allowed limit.
414 Request URI Too Long The length of the request URI has exceeded the maximum allowed limit.
415 Unsupported Media Type The request media type/format is not supported. (e.g., Content-Type value doesn't align with what is expected.)
429 Too Many Requests A rate limit has been exceeded, resulting in the request being throttled.
500 Internal Server Error A system error occurred while processing the request. If this situation persists, please open a support case.
503 Service Unavailable The API is currently unavailable due to maintenance.

post.description:
### Custom carrier CreateLabel (test) behavior

These **test / simulation** rules are driven by `ShipmentOrderCode` and other request fields.

| Trigger | Behavior |
|---------|----------|
| **SAMETRACKING** in `ShipmentOrderCode` | `MasterTrackingNumber` is always `smtrckng`; each package `TrackingNumber` is `smtrckng_package_0`, `smtrckng_package_1`, etc. |
| **TIMEOUT15** in `ShipmentOrderCode` | The response is delayed by about 16 seconds (timeout scenario). |
| **NOMASTERTRACKING** in `ShipmentOrderCode` | `MasterTrackingNumber` is empty; shipment-level `RateDetail` is **null**. |
| **Zone** in `ShipmentOrderCode` (case-sensitive) | Response `Zone` is `ZoneTest`. |
| **DUPTRACK** in `ShipmentOrderCode` (case-sensitive) | Package `TrackingNumber` equals `ShipmentOrderCode` (duplicate tracking). If **SAMETRACKING** also applies, package tracking follows the SAMETRACKING rule. |
| `LabelSpecification.LabelFileType` | **ZPL** uses a sample ZPL URL; **EPL** uses a sample EPL URL; otherwise a sample PDF URL. Labels and the commercial invoice are downloaded from these URLs. |
| `ShippingOption == "CP1"` | The shipment `ShippingOption` in the response is **"CP2"**. |
| Package `PackageSequenceNumber == 0` | `TrackingNumber` follows the master value when DUPTRACK / SAMETRACKING rules do not override it; non-zero sequence numbers use a random tracking number. |
| Otherwise | `ExpectedDeliveryDate` and per-package costs are random; shipment `RateDetail` is returned unless **NOMASTERTRACKING** applies; a base64-encoded invoice is included. |

This endpoint allows you to create, update, or delete product listings in a single request based on the provided payload.

* If the request includes the mandatory fields and no existing product listing matches those fields, a new product listing will be created using the provided data.
* If the request includes the mandatory fields and a matching product listing already exists and at least one field (e.g. channelProductName) is different from the existing record, the existing product listing will be updated with the new values provided in the request.
* If the request includes the mandatory fields and **delete: true** And a matching product listing already exists in the related setup, the existing product listing will be deleted.

**Note:** A maximum of 50 product listings can be sent in a single request.

patch.description:
Performs a partial update on the order. 

**IMPORTANT:** 
1. The request body must contain a list of operations.
2. Follows [RFC 6902](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6902) standard.
### ShipmentOrder — Allowed paths (JSON Patch)

Request body is a **JSON Patch** document (RFC 6902). Each operation uses a **path** that targets a property of `ShipmentOrder`. Below are the allowed paths and their types.

| Path | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| **Root — Identity & basic** | | |
| `/tags` | Guid[] | List of tag identifiers. |
| `/shipmentOrderType` | string | Shipment order type name. |
| `/companyName` | string | Company name (max 250). |
| `/clientReferenceCode` | string | Client reference code. |
| `/note` | string | Note (max 500). |
| `/extraNote1` … `/extraNote5` | string | Extra notes (max 500 each). |
| `/giftNote` | string | Gift note (max 250). |
| `/fraud` | string | Fraud indicator (max 500). |
| `/packingInstructions` | string | Packing instructions (max 1000). |
| `/packingWarningTypeName` | string | Packing warning type name. |
| `/carrierPackageName` | string | Carrier package name. |
| **Dates** | | |
| `/shipmentOrderDate` | DateTime? | Shipment order date. |
| `/expectedShipmentDate` | DateTime? | Expected shipment date. |
| `/expectedDeliveryDate` | DateTime? | Expected delivery date. |
| **Pricing & carrier** | | |
| `/currencyId` | byte? | CurrencyType enum. |
| `/discount` | decimal? | Order discount. |
| `/carrierId` | long? | Carrier ID. |
| `/shippingOptionIdentifier` | Guid? | Shipping option identifier. |
| `/carrierSetupIdentifier` | Guid? | Carrier setup identifier. |
| `/carrierPackageIdentifier` | Guid? | Carrier package identifier. |
| `/trackingNumbers` | string[] | Tracking numbers list. |
| `/priority` | int? | Priority. |
| **Flags** | | |
| `/gift` | bool? | Gift flag. |
| `/isSkipAddressVerification` | bool? | Skip address verification. |
| `/isPrimeOrder` | bool? | Prime order flag. |
| **Nested objects** | | |
| `/shipmentAddress` | object | **ShipmentAddress** — see nested fields below. |
| `/billingAddress` | object | **BillingAddressDto** — see nested fields below. |
| `/customer` | object | **Customer** — see nested fields below. |
| `/retailerDetails` | object | **RetailDetails** — see nested fields below. |
| `/taxDetails` | array | Item: **Tax** — see nested fields below. |
| `/shipmentOrderLineList` | array | Item: **ShipmentOrderLine** — see nested fields below. |

### CurrencyType (currencyId)
**currencyId** accepts the following byte values (CurrencyType enum):

| Value | Code | Currency |
|-------|------|----------|
| `0`  |  —  | None |
| `1`  | USD | U.S. Dollar |

| `3`  | CAD | Canadian Dollar |
| `4`  | GBP | Pound Sterling |
| `5`  | INR | Indian Rupee |
| `6`  | TRY | Turkish Lira |
| `7`  | SGD | Singapore Dollar |
| `8`  | PKR | Pakistani Rupee |
| `9`  | PHP | Philippine Peso |
| `10` | THB | Thai Baht |
| `11` | AUD | Australian Dollar |
| `12` | IDR | Indonesian Rupiah |
| `13` | MYR | Malaysian Ringgit |
| `14` | NGN | Nigerian Naira |
| `15` | XOF | West African Franc |

Example JSON Patch body: `[{"op":"replace","path":"/note","value":"Handle with care."},{"op":"replace","path":"/expectedDeliveryDate","value":"2025-03-15T18:00:00Z"}]`
### Validation rules (ShipmentOrder)

The following rules apply to the **resulting document** after applying the JSON Patch operations.

| Field | Rules |
|-------|--------|
| **Note** | If provided: max 500 characters. |
| **ExtraNote1** … **ExtraNote5** | If provided: max 500 characters each. |
| **GiftNote** | If provided: max 250 characters. |
| **Fraud** | If provided: max 500 characters. |
| **PackingInstructions** | If provided: max 1000 characters. |
| **CompanyName** | If provided: max 250 characters. |
| **BillingAddress.CompanyName** | If provided: max 250 characters. |
| **CurrencyId** | If provided: must be a valid **CurrencyType** enum value. |

### Business rules (post-allocation / post-label)

Depending on the order status and whether a label has been created, the API enforces that some fields **cannot be changed** (must equal the current order). Violations return an error with code `{Field}_FIELD_CANNOT_BE_MODIFIED_AFTER_POST_ALLOCATION` or `{Field}_FIELD_CANNOT_BE_MODIFIED_AFTER_POST_LABEL`.

**1. Pre-label (no shipment label and no return label yet)**  
If the order has neither a shipment label nor a return label, the following applies when you send a patch that touches these fields:

| Field | Rule |
|-------|------|
| **shipmentOrderType** | If provided in patch, must equal the existing order’s shipment order type. |

**2. Post-allocation (order status: Ready to Pick, Picking Started, Ready to Pack, or Shipped)**  
For orders in one of these statuses, the **resulting document** after applying the patch must satisfy:

| Field | Rule |
|-------|------|
| **shipmentOrderType** | Cannot be changed; must equal the existing order’s shipment order type. |
| **discount** | Cannot be changed; must equal the existing order’s discount. |
| **taxDetails** | Cannot be changed; must equal the existing order’s tax list (same set: taxId, taxTypeId, taxTypeName). |
| **expectedDeliveryDate** | If both the order and the patch have expectedShipmentDate set, cannot be changed; must equal the existing order’s expected delivery date. |
| **shipmentOrderLineList** | Cannot be changed; must equal the existing order lines: same count; for each line, same sku+packType and same packQuantity, lotBatchNumber, expiryDate, warehouseLocationCode, licensePlate, productionDate. UnitPrice, unitTax, unitDiscount are **not** compared in this phase. |

**3. Post-label (order has shipment label and/or return label)**  
Once a label exists, the following fields, if present in the **resulting document**, cannot be changed (must equal the existing order):

| Field | Rule |
|-------|------|
| **customer** | If provided: cannot be changed; email, firstName, lastName must equal the order’s customer. |

2. Follows [RFC 6902](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6902) standard.
### ShipmentOrder — Allowed paths (JSON Patch)

Request body is a **JSON Patch** document (RFC 6902). Each operation uses a **path** that targets a property of `ShipmentOrder`. Below are the allowed paths and their types.

| Path | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| **Root — Identity & basic** | | |

| `/clientReferenceCode` | string | Client reference code. |
| `/note` | string | Note (max 500). |
| `/extraNote1` … `/extraNote5` | string | Extra notes (max 500 each). |
| `/giftNote` | string | Gift note (max 250). |
| `/fraud` | string | Fraud indicator (max 500). |
| `/packingInstructions` | string | Packing instructions (max 1000). |
| `/packingWarningTypeName` | string | Packing warning type name. |
| `/carrierPackageName` | string | Carrier package name. |
| **Dates** | | |
| `/shipmentOrderDate` | DateTime? | Shipment order date. |
| `/expectedShipmentDate` | DateTime? | Expected shipment date. |
| `/expectedDeliveryDate` | DateTime? | Expected delivery date. |
| **Pricing & carrier** | | |
| `/currencyId` | byte? | CurrencyType enum. |
| `/discount` | decimal? | Order discount. |
| `/carrierId` | long? | Carrier ID. |
| `/shippingOptionIdentifier` | Guid? | Shipping option identifier. |
| `/carrierSetupIdentifier` | Guid? | Carrier setup identifier. |
| `/carrierPackageIdentifier` | Guid? | Carrier package identifier. |
| `/trackingNumbers` | string[] | Tracking numbers list. |
| `/priority` | int? | Priority. |
| **Flags** | | |
| `/gift` | bool? | Gift flag. |
| `/isSkipAddressVerification` | bool? | Skip address verification. |
| `/isPrimeOrder` | bool? | Prime order flag. |
| **Nested objects** | | |
| `/shipmentAddress` | object | **ShipmentAddress** — see nested fields below. |
| `/billingAddress` | object | **BillingAddressDto** — see nested fields below. |
| `/customer` | object | **Customer** — see nested fields below. |

### CurrencyType (currencyId)
**currencyId** accepts the following byte values (CurrencyType enum):

| Value | Code | Currency |
|-------|------|----------|
| `0`  |  —  | None |
| `1`  | USD | U.S. Dollar |
| `2`  | EUR | European Euro |
| `3`  | CAD | Canadian Dollar |
| `4`  | GBP | Pound Sterling |
| `5`  | INR | Indian Rupee |
| `6`  | TRY | Turkish Lira |
| `7`  | SGD | Singapore Dollar |
| `8`  | PKR | Pakistani Rupee |
| `9`  | PHP | Philippine Peso |
| `10` | THB | Thai Baht |
| `11` | AUD | Australian Dollar |
| `12` | IDR | Indonesian Rupiah |
| `13` | MYR | Malaysian Ringgit |
| `14` | NGN | Nigerian Naira |
| `15` | XOF | West African Franc |
| `16` | MXN | Mexican Peso |
| `17` | MAD | Moroccan Dirham |

Example JSON Patch body: `[{"op":"replace","path":"/note","value":"Handle with care."},{"op":"replace","path":"/expectedDeliveryDate","value":"2025-03-15T18:00:00Z"}]`
### Validation rules (ShipmentOrder)

The following rules apply to the **resulting document** after applying the JSON Patch operations.

| Field | Rules |
|-------|--------|
| **Note** | If provided: max 500 characters. |
| **ExtraNote1** … **ExtraNote5** | If provided: max 500 characters each. |
| **GiftNote** | If provided: max 250 characters. |
| **Fraud** | If provided: max 500 characters. |
| **PackingInstructions** | If provided: max 1000 characters. |
| **CompanyName** | If provided: max 250 characters. |
| **BillingAddress.CompanyName** | If provided: max 250 characters. |
| **CurrencyId** | If provided: must be a valid **CurrencyType** enum value. |

### Business rules (post-allocation / post-label)

Depending on the order status and whether a label has been created, the API enforces that some fields **cannot be changed** (must equal the current order). Violations return an error with code `{Field}_FIELD_CANNOT_BE_MODIFIED_AFTER_POST_ALLOCATION` or `{Field}_FIELD_CANNOT_BE_MODIFIED_AFTER_POST_LABEL`.

**1. Pre-label (no shipment label and no return label yet)**  
If the order has neither a shipment label nor a return label, the following applies when you send a patch that touches these fields:

| Field | Rule |
|-------|------|
| **shipmentOrderType** | If provided in patch, must equal the existing order’s shipment order type. |

**2. Post-allocation (order status: Ready to Pick, Picking Started, Ready to Pack, or Shipped)**  
For orders in one of these statuses, the **resulting document** after applying the patch must satisfy:

| Field | Rule |
|-------|------|
| **shipmentOrderType** | Cannot be changed; must equal the existing order’s shipment order type. |
| **discount** | Cannot be changed; must equal the existing order’s discount. |
| **taxDetails** | Cannot be changed; must equal the existing order’s tax list (same set: taxId, taxTypeId, taxTypeName). |
| **expectedDeliveryDate** | If both the order and the patch have expectedShipmentDate set, cannot be changed; must equal the existing order’s expected delivery date. |
| **shipmentOrderLineList** | Cannot be changed; must equal the existing order lines: same count; for each line, same sku+packType and same packQuantity, lotBatchNumber, expiryDate, warehouseLocationCode, licensePlate, productionDate. UnitPrice, unitTax, unitDiscount are **not** compared in this phase. |

**3. Post-label (order has shipment label and/or return label)**  
Once a label exists, the following fields, if present in the **resulting document**, cannot be changed (must equal the existing order):

| Field | Rule |
|-------|------|
| **customer** | If provided: cannot be changed; email, firstName, lastName must equal the order’s customer. |
| **shipmentAddress** | If provided: cannot be changed; postalCode, addressLine1, addressLine2, city, country, phoneNumber, state must equal the order’s shipment address. |
| **shipmentOrderType** | Cannot be changed. |
| **currencyId** | Cannot be changed. |
| **carrierId** | Cannot be changed. |
| **shippingOptionIdentifier** | Cannot be changed. |
| **carrierSetupIdentifier** | Cannot be changed. |
| **carrierPackageIdentifier** | Cannot be changed. |
| **carrierPackageName** | Cannot be changed. |
| **trackingNumbers** | If provided and non-empty: cannot be changed; must equal the order’s tracking numbers (same sequence). |
| **isSkipAddressVerification** | Cannot be changed. |
| **taxDetails** | Cannot be changed; must equal the order’s tax list (same set). |
| **shipmentOrderLineList** | Cannot be changed; must equal the order lines including **unitPrice**, **unitTax**, and **unitDiscount** per line. |
